title: Real-time dynamic graph construction and reasoning to support human-AI collaborative product conceptual design

context_summary: The paper proposes a real-time dynamic graph method for human-AI collaborative design, using RFLP ontology and LLMs. It includes a user study with 24 participants comparing chat-only AI and the proposed method.
